use default

let opcodes =
    LIST(["NOP", "LDA", "STA", "ADD", "SUB", "BRZ", "JMP", "STP"])

assemble(source: string) -> LIST[int] is
    let lines = source.trim_end().split(['\n'])
        |> map(line => line.split([';'])[0].trim())
        |> collect_list()

    let labels = MAP()

    for (address, line) in lines |> index() do
        if line.contains(':') then
            labels.add(line.split([':'])[0].trim(), address)
        fi
    od

    let memory = LIST()

    for line in lines do
        let body =
            if line.contains(':') then line.split([':'])[1] else line fi
        let words = body.split([' '])
            |> filter(w => w.length > 0)
            |> collect_list()

        if words.count == 0 then
            memory.add(0)
            continue
        fi

        let opcode = opcodes.index_of(words[0])
        let operand = words[words.count - 1]
        let argument =
            if opcode >= 0 /\ words.count == 1 then 0
            elif labels.contains_key(operand) then labels[operand]
            else int.parse(operand) fi

        memory.add(
            if opcode >= 0 then opcode * 32 + argument else argument fi)
    od

    while memory.count < 32 do
        memory.add(0)
    od

    return memory
si

run(memory: LIST[int]) -> int is
    let accumulator mut = 0
    let counter mut = 0

    while counter < 32 do
        let instruction = memory[counter]
        let argument = instruction % 32

        counter = counter + 1

        case opcodes[instruction / 32]
        when "LDA" then accumulator = memory[argument]
        when "STA" then memory[argument] = accumulator
        when "ADD" then accumulator = (accumulator + memory[argument]) % 256
        when "SUB" then
            accumulator = (accumulator - memory[argument] + 256) % 256
        when "BRZ" then if accumulator == 0 then counter = argument fi
        when "JMP" then counter = argument
        when "STP" then return accumulator
        esac
    od

    return accumulator
si

let programs = [
    ("2+2",
     "        LDA   x\n"
     "        ADD   y       ; accumulator = x + y\n"
     "        STP\n"
     "x:            2\n"
     "y:            2\n"),
    ("7*8",
     "loop:   LDA   prodt\n"
     "        ADD   x\n"
     "        STA   prodt\n"
     "        LDA   y\n"
     "        SUB   one\n"
     "        STA   y\n"
     "        BRZ   done\n"
     "        JMP   loop\n"
     "done:   LDA   prodt   ; to display it\n"
     "        STP\n"
     "x:            8\n"
     "y:            7\n"
     "prodt:        0\n"
     "one:          1\n"),
    ("fibonacci",
     "loop:   LDA   n\n"
     "        STA   temp\n"
     "        ADD   m\n"
     "        STA   n\n"
     "        LDA   temp\n"
     "        STA   m\n"
     "        LDA   count\n"
     "        SUB   one\n"
     "        BRZ   done\n"
     "        STA   count\n"
     "        JMP   loop\n"
     "done:   LDA   n       ; to display it\n"
     "        STP\n"
     "m:            1\n"
     "n:            1\n"
     "temp:         0\n"
     "count:        8       ; valid range: 1-11\n"
     "one:          1\n"),
    ("linked list",
     "start:  LDA   load\n"
     "        ADD   car     ; head of list\n"
     "        STA   ldcar\n"
     "        ADD   one\n"
     "        STA   ldcdr   ; next CONS cell\n"
     "ldcar:  NOP\n"
     "        STA   value\n"
     "ldcdr:  NOP\n"
     "        BRZ   done    ; 0 stands for NIL\n"
     "        STA   car\n"
     "        JMP   start\n"
     "done:   LDA   value   ; CAR of last CONS\n"
     "        STP\n"
     "load:   LDA   0\n"
     "value:        0\n"
     "car:          28\n"
     "one:          1\n"
     "                      ; order of CONS cells\n"
     "                      ; in memory\n"
     "                      ; does not matter\n"
     "              6\n"
     "              0       ; 0 stands for NIL\n"
     "              2       ; (CADR ls)\n"
     "              26      ; (CDDR ls) -- etc.\n"
     "              5\n"
     "              20\n"
     "              3\n"
     "              30\n"
     "              1       ; value of (CAR ls)\n"
     "              22      ; points to (CDR ls)\n"
     "              4\n"
     "              24\n"),
    ("prisoner's dilemma",
     "p:            0       ; NOP in first round\n"
     "c:            0\n"
     "start:  STP           ; wait for p's move\n"
     "pmove:  NOP\n"
     "        LDA   pmove\n"
     "        SUB   cmove\n"
     "        BRZ   same\n"
     "        LDA   pmove\n"
     "        STA   cmove   ; tit for tat\n"
     "        BRZ   cdeft\n"
     "        LDA   c       ; p defected, c did not\n"
     "        ADD   three\n"
     "        STA   c\n"
     "        JMP   start\n"
     "cdeft:  LDA   p\n"
     "        ADD   three\n"
     "        STA   p\n"
     "        JMP   start\n"
     "same:   LDA   pmove\n"
     "        STA   cmove   ; tit for tat\n"
     "        LDA   p\n"
     "        ADD   one\n"
     "        ADD   pmove\n"
     "        STA   p\n"
     "        LDA   c\n"
     "        ADD   one\n"
     "        ADD   pmove\n"
     "        STA   c\n"
     "        JMP   start\n"
     "cmove:        0       ; co-operate initially\n"
     "one:          1\n"
     "three:        3\n")
]

for (name, source) in programs do
    write_line("{name}: {run(assemble(source))}")
od
